title: From Faith to Atheism: Ex Pastor's Thoughts on Purpose

top_liked.text:

top_liked.author: @kariannecrysler
top_liked.text: I have done the work to find out who I am. This was essential to understand what I was going to make my purpose in my time here. If you can not swim, your purpose is probably not gonna be as a lifeguard. Understanding how you operate, your likes/dislikes, your weaknesses &…

top_liked.author: @One-Zig
top_liked.text: Thanks for the video. Scissors, pens, matches have a “purpose.” People have preferences, motivations, goals, priorities, and aspirations that change over time. Most Christians ponder Yahweh’s “purpose” for them on Sunday morning but the rest of the time function exactly as I do.
